import unicodedata

def fit(text: str, width: int) -> str:
    """Shorten text to fit in width terminal columns."""
    
    def display_width(char: str) -> int:
        """Calculate display width of a single character."""
        # Combining marks (Mn, Me) and format characters (Cf) take 0 columns
        category = unicodedata.category(char)
        if category in ('Mn', 'Me', 'Cf'):
            return 0
        
        # East Asian Width: Wide (W) and Fullwidth (F) take 2 columns
        ea_width = unicodedata.east_asian_width(char)
        if ea_width in ('W', 'F'):
            return 2
        
        # Everything else takes 1 column
        return 1
    
    # Calculate total width of the text
    total_width = sum(display_width(char) for char in text)
    
    # If it already fits, return unchanged
    if total_width <= width:
        return text
    
    # Need to truncate with "…"
    ellipsis = "…"
    ellipsis_width = 1
    available_width = width - ellipsis_width
    
    current_width = 0
    last_fit_index = 0
    
    for i, char in enumerate(text):
        char_width = display_width(char)
        
        # Check if adding this character would exceed available width
        if current_width + char_width > available_width:
            # Don't include this character
            break
        
        current_width += char_width
        last_fit_index = i + 1
    
    # Return the prefix that fits plus ellipsis
    return text[:last_fit_index] + ellipsis
